recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有數顆大型細胞聚成一小群，細胞質豐富深藍、核偏心呈卵圓形，細胞質中有一塊離核較遠的淡染區（hof），外形像漿細胞但體積大得多，這是造骨細胞（osteoblasts）。
features: Small cluster of large cells, several times the size of plasma cells
Abundant deep blue cytoplasm with ill-defined, confluent cell borders
Eccentric oval nuclei with fine to reticular chromatin and small nucleoli
Pale cytoplasmic clear zone (Golgi) located away from the nucleus
Surrounding normal granulocytic and erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cluster of large cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm, eccentric oval nuclei with fine reticular chromatin and small nucleoli, and a pale cytoplasmic clear zone separated from the nucleus. Surrounding myeloid and erythroid precursors are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with osteoblasts, a normal marrow constituent that is more common in children and in conditions of active bone formation.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are much smaller with clumped clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof immediately adjacent to the nucleus.
Carcinoma cells show nuclear pleomorphism, molding, prominent nucleoli and cohesive three-dimensional clusters, and are keratin positive.
Plasmablasts have large nucleoli and high N:C ratio and appear as a monoclonal population, confirmed by CD138 and light chain restriction.
